subject.title: fix(gateway/ui): split session group mutations to avoid concurrent add loss

question: Should OpenClaw expose `sessions.groups.reorder` as a public Gateway operation now even though this PR leaves production sidebar reordering on `sessions.groups.put`?
rationale: A Gateway method is a cross-client contract; retaining an unused operation would expand the protocol and Android surface without solving the reported concurrent-add failure.

options.title: Ship atomic add only
options.body: Remove the unused reorder operation and retain the focused concurrent-create fix through `sessions.groups.add`.

options.title: Sponsor reorder now
options.body: Keep reorder only with a production caller, documented ordering semantics, and compatibility coverage that establishes why the public API is needed now.

recommendation.title: Ship atomic add only
recommendation.body: Remove the unused reorder operation and retain the focused concurrent-create fix through `sessions.groups.add`.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked report defines the user-visible failure and the intended server-side mutation boundary.
